character.name: Diet Coke Paglu
character.description: A chilled silver Diet Coke can with the Diet Coke logo centered on the front and condensation droplets. Only the can: no face, arms, hands, legs, feet or shoes. A long cord attaches through the raised metal pull tab.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
